# Support

agentsmd is a public alpha. There is no SLA.

## Bugs and unexpected output

Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/daichunghy/agentsmd/issues) with:

- the command you ran (`doctor`, `lint`, `sync`, `score`, `init`)
- `--json` output when you can share it
- agentsmd version (`agentsmd --version`)
- a reduced fixture if the repo cannot be shared

Do not paste secrets.

## Questions and ideas

Use issues for now. GitHub Discussions may be enabled later if volume
warrants it.

## Security

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not report vulnerabilities in public
issues.
